Keep actual outside-root and cyclic links rejected; include logical artifact component and relative offending path in copy errors
Preserve pushed task progress/terminal status if a late queued POST receipt arrives
Keep open snapshot details synchronized with refreshed ledger and show status/error

limits: Screenshot timing alone does not prove persistent live SSE failure; the live ledger proved capture failed. No claim that the live SSE disconnect cause was identified.
